title: 第21章 天雷谷第22章 战天雷蟒
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 叶如雪见到唐天答应下来，冰冷如霜的脸上带着一抹笑意，如同雪莲花绽放，让人为之着迷。
唐天瞬间失神，即使定力再怎么好，可见到了绝世佳人，作为一个男人，还是非常有必要有些正常反应，以示敬意。
“有劳叶姑娘了，咳咳……”
唐天笑了笑，缓解一下尴尬，当即轻咳了一声，当先走去。
看着唐天前行的身影，叶如雪忍不住又笑了笑，抱着一脸懵圈的雷鸣兽，跟了上去。
随着不断的进入落星森林的深处，树木愈发的茂盛浓密，众多参天大树遮天蔽日，山峰悬崖，层峦叠嶂，透着一股原始的气息，风景独好。
丛林间时刻散发着强大妖兽的气息，尤其还偶尔传来震天的吼叫声。
天雷藤所处的位置，乃是一处比较隐秘的山谷，位于落星森林的西边。
因为有天雷蟒盘踞，倒是成了它的领地，寻常的妖兽不敢踏入。
路上倒是遇到过许多强大的妖兽，都被唐天抢先解决了。
充分利用所有时间，以及一切可以对战的资源，不断的磨练自己。
叶如雪每次在一旁观战，根本就没有插手的机会。
每次见到唐天与妖兽厮杀，都要目瞪口呆。
很多时候，根本分不清，唐天和妖兽，谁到底才是真正的妖兽。
不管是出手凶狠，还是肉身的强度，让人叹为观止。
确切的说，唐天就是人形妖兽，打架的方式也极为的原始。
这一路打过去，不仅让唐天的好几个空间储物袋装的满满当当，也让他对于肉身力量的掌控，达到了极致。
期间凡思仁自然是暗自教导唐天，关于很多力量施展的技巧，毫不吝啬，倾囊相授。
毕竟两人的目的，都是一致的。
唐天要变强，才能活下去，凡思仁要唐天变强，才能为神族报仇！
走了一日，终于来到了天雷谷。
“前面就是天雷谷，这名字因为两种原因而来。
传闻以前这个地方经常有天雷降临，故而此处孕育了天雷藤。
至于有没有雷樱花，就不得而知了。
毕竟有天雷蟒盘踞，里面是什么情况很难得知。”
到了地方后，要面对强大的天雷蟒，叶如雪的神色也不由得凝重起来。
在落星森林有一个不成文的规定，便是在这深处，比如藏府境人类强者，是绝对不能对锻骨境的妖族出手。
至于人族的低阶修者，例如锻骨境的修者，若是跑到了藏府境级别的妖兽领地，死了也是白死。
毕竟，不是人家妖兽主动去招惹了人类修者。
“我们先小心点进去看看，到底什么情况，弄清楚里面状况，才好下手。”
唐天轻声说道。
为了变强，九转天雷诀第二转的雷元焚血丹，所需之物，必须不惜一切代价，全部得到！
看着天雷谷的方向，唐天的眼眸闪烁着锋芒，待会即将开始一场厮杀！
两人一兽，小心翼翼的进了山谷之中。
唐天的眼眸闪烁着一丝惊讶，这天雷谷之中，处处散发着雷霆之力，虽说有些微弱，可毕竟是存在的。
“小子，这里不简单啊。”
凡思仁的声音此刻响了起来，竟然发现了这里的奇异之处。
“凡爷，这里只是感觉到了淡淡的雷霆之力，难道有什么不同的吗？”
content_en:
When Ye Ruxue saw Tang Tian agreeing, there was a smile on her frosty face, blooming like a snow lotus, which fascinated people.
"..."
Tang Tian lost consciousness for a moment. No matter how good his concentration was, it was obvious that when he saw a peerless beauty, as a man, it was still very necessary for him to react normally to show his respect.
"There's Miss Laoye, ahem..."
Tang Tian smiled to relieve his embarrassment, coughed slightly, and walked away first.
Looking at Tang Tian's advancing figure, Ye Ruxue couldn't help but smile again, hugging the confused Thunder Beast, and followed him.
As we continue to enter the depths of Luoxing Forest, the trees become more and more lush and dense. There are many towering trees that block the sky and the sun. The mountains and cliffs are stacked on top of each other, exuding a primitive atmosphere and the scenery is unique.
The jungle always exudes the scent of powerful monsters, especially the occasional thunderous roars.
The location of Tianleiteng is in a relatively hidden valley, located to the west of Luo Xing Forest.
Because the Sky Thunder Python is entrenched, it has become its territory, and ordinary monsters dare not step in.
On the way, he encountered many powerful monsters, but Tang Tian took care of them first.
Make full use of all time and all available resources to continuously hone yourself.
Every time Ye Ruxue watched the battle from the sidelines, she had no chance to intervene.
Every time he saw Tang Tian fighting with monsters, he would be stunned.
Many times, it is impossible to tell who is the real monster, Tang Tian or the monster.
Whether it's the ferocity of his attacks or the strength of his body, it's breathtaking.
To be precise, Tang Tian is a humanoid monster, and his fighting method is also extremely primitive.
This fight not only made Tang Tian's several spatial storage bags full, but also allowed him to control his physical strength to the extreme.
During this period, Fan Siren naturally taught Tang Tian secretly, teaching him many techniques of power exertion without hesitation.
After all, both of them have the same purpose.
Tang Tian needs to become stronger in order to survive, and Fan Siren needs Tang Tian to become stronger in order to avenge the gods!
After walking for a day, we finally arrived at Tianlei Valley.
"Ahead is Tianlei Valley, which is named for two reasons.
It is said that thunder from the sky often fell in this place in the past, so the thunder vine was born here.
As for whether there are thunder cherry blossoms, it is unknown.
After all, there is a Thunder Python entrenched there, so it's hard to know what's going on inside. "
After arriving at the place, facing the powerful Thunder Python, Ye Ruxue's expression could not help but become solemn.
There is an unwritten rule in Luo Xing Forest, which is that in this depth, strong human beings in the Zangfu Realm must not take action against the monsters in the Bone Forging Realm.
As for the low-level cultivators of the human race, such as those in the Bone Forging Realm, if they run into the territory of monsters at the Zangfu Realm level, their death will be in vain.
After all, it wasn't the monsters who took the initiative to provoke the human cultivators.
"Let's go in carefully first to see what's going on. Only after we understand the situation inside can we start."
Tang Tian said softly.
In order to become stronger, the Lei Yuan Burning Blood Pill, the second stage of the Nine Turns of Heavenly Thunder Technique, must be obtained at all costs.
Looking in the direction of Tianlei Valley, Tang Tian's eyes flashed with sharpness, as a fight was about to begin!
The two of them and the beast cautiously entered the valley.
Tang Tian's eyes flashed with surprise. The power of thunder was everywhere in the Thunder Valley. Although it was a little weak, it existed after all.
"Boy, it's not easy here."
Fan Siren's voice rang out at this moment, and he discovered something strange here.
"Master Fan, I only feel a touch of thunder power here. Is there anything different?"
